title:
Transform for `FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetAlert>` for getting the `Comments` and `Files Uploaded`.
Also sets `mostRecentFeedbackCategory` to '--' if it doesn't exist.

This transform accepts a JSON object with the following properties:
fetchResult - `FetchResult<ReliabilityAssetAlert>`s to transform

This transform returns `FetchResult<json>` with:
- `commentCount` - number of comments in the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}
- `filesCount` - number of file attachments in the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}
name: UiSdlTransformReliabilityAssetCaseGetDataCountFromFetchResult
